newsitem.title: CANADA: CIBC '96 loan loss provision falls C$200 mln.
newsitem.headline: CIBC '96 loan loss provision falls C$200 mln.

text.p: Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce said on Thursday that its 1996 provision for loan losses fell to C$480 million, down from C$680 million in 1995.
The bank said in a statement it also increased its general allowance by C$150 million to C$400 million at year end.
CIBC's net impaired loans in the fourth quarter ended October 31 fell sharply to C$692 million from C$1.36 billion in the same quarter a year ago.
Net impaired loans as a percentage of total loans and acceptances dropped to 0.5 percent in the quarter, down from 1.2 percent in the fourth quarter of 1995.
